messages:
Rae (PM): Quick thread
Customer asks for sub-60ms token latency for short prompts. Sales wants this in the MVP for pilot tenants. Decision: ship as opt-in MVP feature behind a flag or defer to v1? Need alignment by EOD.

Liam (Eng): Fast-path low-precision variant is implementable as an opt-in alpha flag. Risk: quality regressions and extra QA. Rough dev: 1.5 sprint for safe rollout plus telemetry.

Ana (Sales): Pilot starts in 12 days. Customer will accept an "experimental" label and opt-in if we can promise rollback and clear contract language. They prefer MVP inclusion.

Maya (Design): If opt-in, UI must make default stable. Provide copy: "Low-latency (experimental)" + tooltip describing quality tradeoffs. Avoid exposing as default.

Kai (SRE): We can canary-route to a small pool in us-east1, pre-warm caches, and add autoscale cushions. Add an alert: p95 > 100ms or GPU>85% triggers rollback.

Liam (Eng): Proposal: Enable alpha_fastpath flag, 5% canary in us-east1, telemetry hooks for p50/p95, quality-regression metric from eval harness, and auto-rollback on thresholds. I'll open the PR tonight.

Rae (PM): Decision: ship as MVP opt-in (alpha flag) with 5% canary, explicit experimental UI copy, legal-safe pilot addendum from Sales, and SRE rollback alerts. If any gate fails, revert and move feature to v1. I'll update the milestone board and notify stakeholders.

Ana (Sales): I'll draft the pilot addendum and get customer sign-off today.

Liam (Eng): Kicking off regression run with short/long prompt jitter before canary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled at 1900555600 (us-east1, 5%).

Rae (PM): Thanks everyone. Closing thread unless objections.
